extraction_scope: Worker-6 replaced automated mechanism placeholders with source-reviewed, locator-backed claims from methods/results figures and text. Exact plotted values were not fabricated from figures.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: T9W and related peptides permeabilize/depolarize the outer membrane of P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 in an NPN uptake assay; T9K gave the strongest progressive fluorescence increase, and this supports membrane interaction rather than a non-membrane intracellular target claim.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RI16, T9W, T9I, T9K, T9F; lead interpretation for T9W
direct_assay_types: NPN uptake outer membrane permeability assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure values are qualitative/curve-based in local XML/PDF text; exact fluorescence values are not tabulated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: T9W causes rapid inner-membrane depolarization of P. aeruginosa at low concentrations in a diSC3-5 release assay, supporting membrane perturbation as a direct mechanism class.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper states T9W depolarizes at low concentrations; exact curve values are figure-only and not converted to table rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FITC-labeled T9W accumulates at the P. aeruginosa cell surface more than LL37 in confocal microscopy, supporting cell-surface membrane interaction.
direct_assay_types: confocal laser scanning microscopy with FITC-labeled peptide
mechanism_claims.limitations: Localization is qualitative image evidence, not a quantitative uptake table.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: T9W reduces pre-formed P. aeruginosa biofilm biomass in a dose-dependent manner and reduces biofilm cell density at 4×MIC in FE-SEM images.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is antibiofilm phenotype evidence; exact database inhibition percentages are not tabulated locally and remain database conflicts.
